verdict.rationale: Smooth publishes an official `smooth-sdk` repository under circlemind-ai, and the quickstart shows a client-library call (`smooth_client.run(...)`) that runs a task in about 4 lines of code. SDK-level features such as `response_model` structured outputs, custom tools and sessions sit on top of a documented REST API. missing for 10: explicit SDK install/package docs, a list of supported languages, a dedicated SDK reference, a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.
